# ✨ Throw Alike
Throw Alike is a client-side Fabric mod that makes thrown items look like they do in your hand.

## 🌟 Features
- 🪃 Thrown items use their held item model instead of the default dropped model.
- 🎨 Fully supports custom models, resource packs, and model overrides.
- ⚡ Lightweight with virtually no performance impact.
- 💻 100% client-side — works on any server with no installation required.
- 🔄 Supports all throwable items that use Minecraft's item renderer.
